scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure
other_conditions: Eligible institutions include any Industries Association, Chamber of Commerce, industry or SPV of industries registered under the Societies Act, Trust Act or Companies Act, large projects/group of industries, any Government Department, Government Agency or Authority, State and Central Government PSUs, Boards, Corporations, and Municipal Corporations.

Eligible activities comprise common infrastructure facilities such as approach roads, over‑bridges, road up‑gradation, bypass roads, earth stations, water/gas/electricity/energy distribution networks, common warehousing, incubation centres, product development centres, training centres, convention/exhibition centres, business support centres, testing laboratories, fire stations, water desalination plants, transport facilities, water augmentation, networking facilities, primary health centres, trauma/emergency centres, alternative energy projects, sewage and drainage networks, and other infrastructure approved by the SLEC.
Fixed capital investment in the project (excluding land cost) approved by the SLEC is eligible for assistance.
Costs of preparation of work estimates, technical sanction, and third‑party inspection are eligible up to 5 % of the project cost or ₹20,00,000, whichever is less.
Up‑gradation of existing infrastructure facilities is eligible only if the facility was established at least seven years prior.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 80% of the eligible project cost (capped at ₹25 crore) per project, with supplementary assistance to meet 80% total, and up to 90% for MSE clusters.
application_link: Step 1: The Eligible Institution applies with a project report to the Industries Commissionerate. Step 2: The Industries Commissionerate scrutinizes the proposal and places it before the SLEC for decision. Step 3: The institution submits a claim of assistance to the Industries Commissionerate in the prescribed proforma as per the guidelines issued by the Industries Commissionerate.
